aboutBodyP1: Quality massage devices, air purifiers, and water filters in Australia were either overpriced, took weeks to arrive, or simply didn't live up to their claims.
aboutBodyP2: We source directly from verified manufacturers, cut out every middleman, and test every product against strict delivery timeframes. If it doesn't arrive fast to Australia — it doesn't make our store.

shippingContent:
🚚 Free Standard Shipping

Free shipping on all orders over $50 AUD. Orders under $50 have a flat $6.95 fee.

⏱️ Delivery Timeframes

  • Metro (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide): 3–7 business days
  • Regional areas: 7–14 business days
  • Remote areas: 14–20 business days

📦 Order Processing

Orders processed within 1–2 business days. Tracking number sent via email once dispatched.

📮 Delivery Partners

We ship via Australia Post, Sendle, and Aramex based on your location.

✉️ Contact

support@purehomestore.com.au — reply within 1 business day.
privacyContent:
1. Introduction

Pure Home Store is committed to protecting your information under the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles.

2. Information We Collect

  • Name, email, phone number
  • Delivery and billing address
  • Purchase history

3. How We Use It

  • Process and fulfil orders
  • Send order and tracking updates
  • Marketing emails/SMS (with consent only, per Spam Act 2003)

4. Marketing

Every communication includes an unsubscribe option. Reply STOP to opt out of SMS.

5. Security

All payments processed via PCI-compliant gateways. We never store card details.

6. Contact

privacy@purehomestore.com.au
